dam_break_convergence_supplement.interpretation: Adjacent differences shrink modestly, while agreement with the1952experiment worsens under refinement. Neither the coarse pass nor this three-level trend establishes asymptotic convergence or physical validity.
dam_break_convergence_supplement.dissipation_hypothesis: Reduced numerical dissipation under refinement and unmodeled release/bottom effects can explain a faster front. These data do not isolate that cause from boundary/finite-width/solver-discretization errors; no viscosity/clock correction was fitted.
dam_break_convergence_supplement.count_correction: 240/1920/15360 are the separate robot-pour resolutions. The existing dam-break column is432/3456; a1024-particle intermediate preserves its0.06x0.06x0.12m geometry instead of changing the shape to force requested counts.
